items.difficulty_reason: Counts the author Lemma: for a system of ring maps A_i -> B_i over a directed index set I, the colimit of the cotangent complexes is the cotangent complex of the colimits (source lines 373-377). The proof observes that the forgetful functor from A-algebras to sets and its adjoint commute with filtered colimits, and that the functor sending a ring map B/A to Omega_{B/A} does as well by the corresponding algebra lemma; together these give the compatibility of the construction of the cotangent complex with filtered colimits.
